# Prateek Associates

> Integrated professional consultancy offering legal advocacy, CA & taxation compliance, and commercial property advisory across New Delhi and Uttar Pradesh. Founded and led by Advocate Prateek Pal.

## Core Identity & Chambers
- **Firm Name**: Prateek Associates
- **Founder & Lead Counsel**: Advocate Prateek Pal (Supreme Court of India & Delhi High Court Practice)
- **Official Website**: https://www.prateekpal.com/
- **Official Email**: support@prateekpal.com
- **Direct Phone**: +91 9794801100
- **New Delhi Chambers**: Chamber No. 527, Patiala House Courts, India Gate, New Delhi - 110001
- **Uttar Pradesh Office**: Loco Road, Near Maseni Chauraha, Fatehgarh, Post Farrukhabad, Uttar Pradesh - 209625

## Practice Divisions

### 1. Advocacy & Appellate Litigation
- Practice Jurisdictions: Supreme Court of India, High Court of Delhi, Allahabad High Court, National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT), Debt Recovery Appellate Tribunal (DRAT), and District Courts.
- Specializations: Constitutional Writ Petitions, Commercial Dispute Litigation, Civil Appeals, Special Leave Petitions (SLPs), Tax Dispute Representation, and Corporate Contracts Drafting.

### 2. CA & Taxation Advisory
- Services: GST Compliance & Departmental Audit Representation, Income Tax Returns (ITR) Assessments & Scrutiny Appeals, Corporate Financial Statements, Working Capital CMA Data, and Statutory Business Registrations.

### 3. Property & Real Estate Consultancy
- Services: 30-Year Title Search Verification, Conveyance & Sale Deed Drafting, Commercial Property Acquisition Due Diligence, RERA Advisory & Grievance Filings, and Local Authority Registry Liaison.
